name: Northwest Lumber Co
old_description: , intended to be used for furniture, musical instruments, fine cabinetry, boats, etc.
about:
Northwest Lumber Company has operated from the same Indianapolis, Indiana location since Harry Greeley and his wife Eva founded the business in 1956. What began as a mom-and-pop hardware store selling construction-grade plywood and lumber transitioned over the decades into a specialty supplier of furniture-grade hardwoods, cabinet-grade plywood, exotic tone-woods for instrument building, and fine woodworking hand tools. The company remains family-owned, now managed by the third generation of Greeleys.

The company stocks hardwood lumber graded Selects & Better, along with cabinet-grade plywood and a selection of exotic tone-woods suited for musical instruments, fine cabinetry, furniture, and boat building. It also carries a curated line of fine woodworking hand tools. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers include furniture makers, luthiers, cabinet shops, and boat builders seeking high-grade hardwoods and specialty tone-woods. The firm serves both professional woodworkers and hobbyists through its retail showroom, which is open Monday through Friday 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. and Saturday mornings.

The shift from construction materials to fine woodworking supplies was driven by the arrival of big-box retailers in the market. Northwest Lumber Company is a member of the Indiana Hardwood Lumbermen's Association, reflecting a stated commitment to sustainable forest productivity and the production of high-quality hardwood products.

name: Nu-Source Technologies
old_description: Nu-Source Technologies fabricates electrical switchgear and distribution panels. Its turnkey solutions serve the telecom, energy and industrial sectors.
about:
Nu-Source Technologies, based in Shirley, New York, has been operating since 1990. The company is part of the Brand Felt Group family of companies and is transitioning its product offerings to a new purchase platform.

Nu-Source operates as a manufacturer, converter, and wholesaler of felts, foams, and cork materials. Its capabilities include custom slitting, stripping, and cutting of materials such as carbon felt, neoprene foam, cork rubber blends, and wool-blend felts. The company also produces USA-made high-temperature welding blankets, tool box liners for brands like Craftsman, Matco, and Snap-on, and custom gasket materials. With a headcount of 10–49 employees, it serves both custom orders and an online wholesale store.

The company’s materials and products find use in industrial, welding, plumbing, automotive, and crafting sectors. Database records indicate it also serves telecom, energy, and industrial markets with switchgear and power distribution panels, though the current web presence emphasizes material supply.

Nu-Source highlights its commitment to USA-made materials, offering domestic neoprene foams, adhesives, and welding blankets. Its affiliation with the Brand Felt Group provides a broader portfolio and wholesale direct pricing.

name: O&G Studio
old_description: We respect your privacy and inbox: only thoughtful mail, we promise.
about:
O&G Studio operates from a factory in Warren, Rhode Island. The company was founded in 2009 by Jonathan Glatt and Sara Ossana. Glatt, who serves as creative director and CEO, brought a background in jewelry and antiques to the venture, shaping a design language that blends historical and natural reference with sculptural clarity.

The studio produces a full range of seating, tables, lighting, decorative accents, and cabinet hardware. Its hardware collections — including Cygnet, Atlantic, and Cleat — are crafted in solid brass with a variety of finishes. A team of over 25 craftspeople and design professionals handles woodworking, metal finishing, upholstery, and assembly under one roof in the Rhode Island facility.

O&G serves interior designers, architects, and collectors worldwide through trade accounts and direct specification. The firm's work has been specified in projects featured by The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Architectural Digest, Elle Decor, Wallpaper, Dwell, and other design publications. Vogue named Glatt one of ten contemporary designers to collect today.

The company positions its output as modern heirlooms rooted in authenticity, place, and the wisdom of history as a foundation for invention. Glatt's singular vision combines memory and invention, celebrating New England's design legacy while creating work that is new, surprising, and uniquely its own.

name: ORACLE Lighting
old_description: FREE SHIPPING ON ORDERS $100+ (Continental USA Only, Some Exclusions Apply)
about:
ORACLE Lighting operates from Metairie, Louisiana, where it designs, engineers, manufactures primary housing components, and assembles complete automotive lighting products. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in the provided materials.

The product line centers on LED lighting for trucks, SUVs, off-road vehicles, and classic cars. Offerings include the Oculus™ Switchback Bi‑LED projector headlights, the world’s first lensless LED headlight for the 2016‑2023 Toyota Tacoma, flush‑mount LED tail lights for Jeep Wrangler JL/Gladiator JT and Toyota FJ Cruiser, ColorSHIFT® RGB+W rock lights and underbody kits, the StreetSync™ Pro integrated whip system for UTVs, and a sequential LED tail‑light conversion for 1969‑1970 Dodge Chargers. Assemblies feature modular, serviceable emitters, IP68‑rated waterproof sealing, ballistics‑grade optics, active thermal management, and automotive‑grade thermoset powder‑coat finishes.

Customers span the automotive aftermarket: individual enthusiasts upgrading daily drivers, off‑road and UTV builders, and classic‑car restorers seeking modern lighting with factory‑fit appearance. Vehicle‑specific applications are called out for Jeep Wrangler/Gladiator, Toyota Tacoma and FJ Cruiser, and the 1969‑70 Dodge Charger, with plug‑and‑play harnesses that avoid cutting factory wiring.

The company emphasizes its U.S.‑based design‑to‑assembly flow and a modular architecture that lets users replace individual low‑beam, high‑beam, or DRL modules without removing the entire headlight. A five‑year replacement warranty on every component of the lensless Tacoma headlight underscores the serviceability claim.

name: ORTHOTEK INC
old_description: Since 2001, OrthoTek Inc. has been on a mission to provide durable home medical equipment and pricing that allows independent contractors to sell to patients who need the equipment.
about:
OrthoTek Inc. was founded in 2001 in Des Moines, Iowa. The company began as a supplier of durable home medical equipment, aiming to connect independent contractors with the products their patients need.

OrthoTek distributes a range of durable medical equipment including off-the-shelf bracing, continuous passive motion devices, bone growth stimulation systems, compression therapy units, and negative pressure wound therapy devices. All products are sourced from manufacturers and carry original warranties. The company offers both purchase and rental options, and assists customers with insurance paperwork to secure reimbursement.

The primary customers are independent contractors, hospitals, and physicians’ offices that serve patients requiring home medical equipment. OrthoTek’s focus is on the home healthcare and durable medical equipment sectors, providing equipment that helps patients recover from acute injuries or manage chronic conditions.

The company’s stated mission emphasizes affordability and accessibility, ensuring equipment can be obtained whether the patient rents or buys. OrthoTek is a recognized partner of the Community Health Accreditation Program, which accredits community-based healthcare businesses. With over two decades of experience, the firm positions itself as a reliable link between manufacturers and end users.
